notes.title: EPIC PARTY QUEST - BIG UPDATE!!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello adventurers! [/h2]

[h3]We worked hard on Epic Party Quest, and we have quite a lot of news to announce, so let's go: [/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Price change![/b]
We are thrilled to announce a new, lower price for our game! This change reflects our commitment to making our game more accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Thank you for your continued support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/180b92bef6e565c20bd684d0183c9ead65fd217e.png[/img]

[*] [b]Summer Sale![/b]
Summer is here, and you really shouldn't miss the Summer Sale! You can enjoy the discount on an already lowered price - this is the best opportunity for you, your friends, and your family to get a copy of Epic Party Quest and dive into new adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/c5117f79f05099ec3031e2469a9560e6011f96cb.png[/img]

[*] [b]Mobile Controller![/b]
We are excited to announce the release of a highly anticipated feature: you can now use your mobile phone as a controller for our game! You and your friends can enjoy multiplayer sessions without needing multiple gamepads. Simply connect your phones via Wi-Fi and dive into the fun together. 
You can find the app on the Google Play store, and a QR code to the app is on the very first screen of Epic Party Quest. Thank you for your patience and continued support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/dbec38837179854fb0f3702633bd5d7fbac40073.png[/img]

[*] [b]New languages![/b]
Our game is now available in five new languages: French, German, Turkish, Spanish, and Ukrainian, which is still a work in progress; we will add it very soon! While we've worked hard to make these translations accurate, there might be some errors. We appreciate your understanding and welcome any feedback to help us improve the translation!

[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b]
We have fixed several bugs and errors to enhance your gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback, which helps us make the game better for everyone. Enjoy the improved gameplay!

[*] [b]Demo update[/b]
As always, we applied all of the above to our Demo version, so if you're still not convinced, try it!
[/list]


[h3]Jump back in and enjoy the game like never before![/h3]

notes.title: Hotfix 19.03.2024
notes.notes:
•	The Keyboard Controls layout is now displayed on the first main screen of the game.
•	Fixed the rare bug that caused the main menu to vanish after completing the first full game.
•	Improvements have been made to both the English and Polish languages.
•	Minor bugs in several mini-games have been fixed.

notes.title: Character selection update is live!
notes.notes:
[b]Hi folks![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/76c3a2779a64832870445b3fe902f949938ee33e.png[/img]


After the game's release, we received feedback from you about several bugs. 
First of all, a huge thanks to all of you who reached out to us, whether it was through Steam or email! 

Follow that, we've just dropped a hotfix for our game, and it's packed with some improvements to enhance your experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/6f2bafb079cc421a57b152f4ede83a28f36440aa.png[/img]


In this update, we've addressed several issues, including fixes for character selection and displaying players on the loading screen. We've also added more access points to the 'Exit to Menu' feature and all achievements will unlock properly from now on. 

Please check the full list of hotfix updates in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2024810/view/4151826831544390724?l=english]patch notes[/url].


[b]But wait, there's more! [/b]

The demo version has been improved as well. 
As a reminder, the demo feature two mini-games, picked from the favorites of our playtesters. 
2-4 players are able to play the game locally or by using Steam Remote Play. 

We hope the demo lets you feel the unique vibes of the game and gets you hooked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/269f43a77fd502388a4813a30c89ad98edb32d74.png[/img]

notes.title: Character selection hotfix 29.02.2024
notes.notes:
Epic Party Quest: 

[list]
[*]Character selection has been improved. Players should be able to join the game without major problems now.  
(Please note that there still might be some issues connected to Steam Remote Play. If any troubles occur, please try to relaunch the game and join one more time.) 

[*]Fixed the issue where player sprites were not displaying properly on the loading screen before the mini-game.   

[*]All achievements will unlock properly from now on. 

[*]The number of access points to the 'Exit to menu' screen has been increased. 

[*]Confirmation pop-up now features new graphics. 

[*]Selected character skins should be displayed properly in each mini-game and should not cause any issues inside the mini-game. 

[*]Selecting ‘Random’ mini-game was not working as intended. The system has been improved. 
[/list]

Epic Party Quest (Demo): 

[list]
[*]Demo is now up to date with all the fixes from the main game.  

[*]Added a screen that appears after the end of the demo game. 
[/list]

notes.title: Resolution hotfix 14.02.2024
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] It is possible now to set up 4k resolution in settings menu!
[*] Borderless Fullscreen and windowed mode works properly now.
[*] Slight graphics improvements in the game outro.
[/list]

notes.title: Release date & demo announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We would like to share with you some great news about Epic Party Quest – at the beginning of 2024 you will have an opportunity to try out the demo of the game, and later get yourself a full version and relieve the epic quests of our heroes!

First of all, check our new trailer:

[previewyoutube=-8e3wWgxB3U;full][wideo][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Steam Next Fest demo release![/h2]

The demo will feature a limited selection of mini-games, picked from the favorites of our playtesters. Not every game function will be accessible up there. Nevertheless, up to four players will be able to play the game locally or by using Steam Remote Play.  We hope the demo lets you feel the unique vibes of the game and gets you hooked!

Long story short, you'll be able to test the online demo with your friends in February!

For more information about Steam Remote Play please check the website below:  
https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay

or check out the video on Youtube:
https://youtu.be/ClPgQMi_h8c?si=8cVU7-q38ChCk--y

But wait, there's more! As part of the festivals, you'll get the opportunity to watch a live gameplay of the complete game and get access to the additional articles detailing the game's common features. We'll also share more about the game's future beyond version 1.0!

[h2]Remote Play Together Festival – full game release![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42495655/c83db70a6045b65cc36fea268cc3d59d649bfd81.png[/img]

Right after Next Fest wraps up, Remote Play Together Fest will kick off.  Mark your calendar because that's when full version of Epic Party Quest hits Steam!

The event runs February 12 at  19:00 CET (10:00 AM PST) to February 19 at 19:00 CET (10:00 AM PST).
Additional details about the full game will be available during the Steam Next Fest on our community page! 

[h2]Beyond PC version – Epic Party Quest on consoles![/h2]
While we are still working to bring Epic Party Quest to all modern consoles as well, more information about that will be also available closer to the PC release of the game, so stay tuned!

While waiting you can always check our social media here:
